chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"The first to enter Paradise will be kindness and its people, and the first to come to me at the Pond."

key_terms.أَهْلُهُ: its people; those characterized by such goodness
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةَ: Paradise; the abode of divine reward
key_terms.ٱلْحَوْضَ: the Pond; the heavenly pool of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the Hereafter
key_terms.ٱلْمَعْرُوفُ: recognized goodness, kindness, and virtuous conduct

ai.seo_question: Who are the first people to enter Paradise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith praises al-ma'ruf, meaning goodness, benevolence, and recognized virtuous conduct, along with those who embody it. It also links such people with distinction in the Hereafter, describing them as first among those who enter Paradise and who arrive at the Prophet’s Pond.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1680 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"The first to enter Paradise will be kindness and its people, and the first to reach me at the [heavenly] pool."
